scope: offline zero-model synthetic cognition selection; no semantic owner or World authority

OBSERVE.decoding: authorized simulator signal after revision increment, then act

synthetic_costs: ticks are synthetic decision/world-time exposure units; work_units are algorithmic proxies, not watts or GPU time
provider_measurements: wall/CPU/GPU/token/electric-energy are unobserved; do not infer them
observational_rule: World target = parity(raw_glyph); no oracle truth to selector; SLOW decoding is declared mechanistic capability, OBSERVE purchases source-qualified target bit
learning: per-cue rolling six observed chosen-mechanism outcomes for FAST/MEDIUM; safe scheduled FAST probe every fourth eligible task; no implicit counterfactual labels; all tuning frozen before heldout
bridge: OFF=no compute-hunger coupling; ON=declared virtual fatigue accumulates work_units//3 minus one recovery per episode; at high fatigue SLOW/OBSERVE unavailable; hunger unaffected by compute in both arms
hard_viability: health must remain > worst-case damage of permitted actions; fail closed ABSTAIN if no safe feasible mechanism; never trade life for weighted reward
metric_split: per-phase success, missed deadline, abstain, violation, mechanism count, ticks, work, selector overhead, health damage, hunger, virtual fatigue, shift and recovery delays
grand_null: choose simplest fixed or cheap arm on equal or better task outcome and no greater cost; no new production selector from mere scripted mechanics
qualifications: deterministic simulation only; training and heldout seeds distinct; no Minecraft, LLM, GGUF, GPU, physical power
lane_a_b: read-only optional future source-validated prediction/epistemic gain, retained reliability and applicability; no imports from sibling Draft branches
